back: A scalar has magnitude only (mass, time, speed, work). A vector has magnitude and direction (force, velocity, acceleration).
|a| = √(a₁² + a₂² + a₃²).
a-hat = a / |a|; a vector of magnitude 1.
AB = b − a, where a, b are position vectors of A, B.
Resultant of a and b placed tip-to-tail = a + b (from start of a to end of b).
Diagonal through the common vertex = a + b; the other diagonal = a − b.
Commutative: a+b = b+a; associative: (a+b)+c = a+(b+c); zero: a+0 = a; negative: a+(−a) = 0.
λa is parallel to a, magnitude |λ||a|; direction preserved if λ > 0, reversed if λ < 0.
a and b are collinear iff a = λ b for some scalar λ (non-zero vectors).
P divides AB internally m:n ⇒ p = (n a + m b)/(m+n).
a · b = |a||b| cos θ (θ between 0 and π).
a · b = a₁ b₁ + a₂ b₂ + a₃ b₃.
a ⊥ b ⟺ a · b = 0.
cos θ = (a·b)/(|a||b|).
comp_b a = (a·b)/|b|.
proj_b a = ((a·b)/|b|²) b.
|a × b| = |a||b| sin θ.
a × b = | i j k; a1 a2 a3; b1 b2 b3 | determinant.
Anti-commutative: a × b = −b × a. a × a = 0. Perpendicular to both operands.
a·(b×c) = determinant of [a,b,c]. Volume of parallelepiped; zero iff coplanar.
|a × b|² + (a·b)² = |a|² |b|².
Parallelogram = |a × b|; triangle = ½ |a × b|.
